title: Equipment Lead Times, Storage, Temporary Cooling and After-Hours Charges

# Equipment Lead Times, Storage, Temporary Cooling and After-Hours Charges

Field terms of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects: the quoted lead time per equipment type, the weekly charge for storing delivered equipment the site cannot yet receive, and the two site-condition charges that apply where a class does not include the item.

## Quoted equipment lead times (weeks, all project classes)

The quoted lead time depends on the principal equipment type and is the same in every class.

| Equipment type | Lead time (weeks) |
|---|---|
| rooftop unit | 14 |
| split system | 8 |
| heat pump | 10 |
| VRF system | 18 |
| air handler | 16 |
| chiller | 32 |
| boiler | 20 |
| cooling tower | 22 |
| pump | 6 |
| exhaust fan | 5 |
| makeup air unit | 20 |
| computer room unit | 16 |

## Storage, temporary cooling and after-hours work by class

| Project class | Weekly storage charge (USD per week) | Temporary cooling during changeover included | Temporary cooling where not included (USD per day) | After-hours and weekend installation included | After-hours labor premium where not included (per cent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Equipment Replacement Order | 175 | no | 385 | no | 50 |
| Planned Replacement Program | 195 | no | 365 | no | 45 |
| Controls Retrofit Project | 195 | no | 365 | yes | 0 |
| Energy Retrofit Project | 225 | yes | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Turnkey Mechanical Upgrade Project | 280 | yes | 0 | yes | 0 |
| Design-Build Infrastructure Program | 350 | yes | 0 | yes | 0 |

## Notes

- The weekly storage charge is the class's rate for storing delivered equipment the site cannot yet receive; it is quoted per week.
- Where temporary cooling is included, the daily charge is 0; where it is not, the daily charge is applied for each day the temporary cooling stands on site.
- Where after-hours work is included, the premium is 0; where it is not, the premium is added to the labor of the after-hours or weekend hours only.

## Hypothetical reading

A chiller on any class is quoted at 32 weeks. On an Equipment Replacement Order, temporary cooling standing on site for 3 days is charged at USD 385 per day, USD 1155 in all; on an Energy Retrofit Project the same 3 days carry no charge.
